subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, L, M, N, O, W, X and Y, are sitting in a row, facing north (but not necessarily in the same order) . Only L sits to the left of X. Only four people sit between L and N. Only M sits between O and W, and O is not an immediate neighbour of N. Who sits at the extreme right of the line?
